name: Best Mistakes of Blockwise-Addressing
proof: Example 2 of Ben-David--Kushilevitz--Mansour proves that every fixed presentation order admits an adversarial target forcing $\Omega(d)$ mistakes.  Its general upper bound, together with the class size $2^{d+1}$, gives $O(d)$; hence the best fixed-order mistake bound is $\Theta(d)=\Theta(\log|\mathcal X|)$.
